title.zh-TW: 依分享文案，註冊時輸入邀請碼可得飲品兌換券 1 張
title.en: Per the share text: register with the invite code, get one drink coupon

text.zh-TW: 金桔檸檬飲L 或黑糖冬瓜檸檬飲L 兌換券 1 張，依分享文案由輸入邀請碼完成註冊的人領取。取自平台分享文案；實際內容與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: One coupon for a 金桔檸檬飲L or 黑糖冬瓜檸檬飲L drink, for whoever registers with the code. From the share text; official terms prevail.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」：本站會先複製邀請碼 S7wStYD0，再開啟下載連結（Onelink.to 短網址）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up”: this site copies invite code S7wStYD0, then opens the download link (an Onelink.to short URL).

steps.zh-TW: 開啟連結後，請從 App Store 或 Google Play 的官方上架頁面下載並開啟美廉社 App，開始註冊會員。
steps.en: After opening the link, download the Simple Mart app from its official App Store or Google Play listing, open it, and start registering as a member.

steps.zh-TW: 在註冊時的邀請碼欄位（App 內可能寫作推廣碼）貼上 S7wStYD0；若沒有貼上，請手動輸入，並依原樣區分大小寫。
steps.en: Paste S7wStYD0 into the invite code field (the app may call it 推廣碼); if nothing is pasted, type it in exactly as shown, including capitalization.

steps.zh-TW: 完成註冊後，確認是否收到飲品兌換券；領取條件與期限以官方公告為準。
steps.en: After registering, check whether the drink coupon arrives; conditions and deadlines follow the official announcements.

intro.zh-TW: 美廉社 App 註冊時輸入邀請碼 S7wStYD0，依分享文案可得金桔檸檬飲L 或黑糖冬瓜檸檬飲L 兌換券 1 張。
intro.en: Enter invite code S7wStYD0 when registering in the Simple Mart app; per the share text, you get one drink coupon.

description.zh-TW:
美廉社（三商美廉社，Simple Mart）是台灣的連鎖零售通路，美廉社 App 提供會員註冊，並可在店內出示會員條碼累積點數。本站的連結不含邀請碼：點擊「立即註冊」時，本站會先複製邀請碼 S7wStYD0，再開啟分享文案中的下載連結。

下載並開啟 App 後，註冊時請貼上邀請碼，也可手動輸入，並依原樣區分大小寫。依分享文案，完成註冊可獲得金桔檸檬飲L 或黑糖冬瓜檸檬飲L 兌換券 1 張；實際內容、期限與條件以官方公告為準。
description.en:
Simple Mart (美廉社, also written 三商美廉社) is a retail chain in Taiwan. Its app offers member registration and a member barcode that can be shown in store to earn points. The link on this page does not carry the invite code: selecting “Sign up” first copies code S7wStYD0, then opens the download link from the share text.

After downloading and opening the app, paste the code during registration, or type it in exactly as shown, including capitalization. According to the share text, finishing registration gets one coupon for a 金桔檸檬飲L or a 黑糖冬瓜檸檬飲L drink; actual terms, deadlines and conditions follow the official announcements.

notes.zh-TW:
此連結不含邀請碼，註冊時請貼上或手動輸入 S7wStYD0（區分大小寫）。分享文案稱「邀請碼」，App Store 版本說明則提到註冊時的「推廣碼」，App 內實際欄位名稱請以畫面為準。

連結 onelink.to/rte3n3：2026-10-24 以桌面瀏覽器開啟，會轉到美廉社官方網站（simplemart.com.tw）；行動裝置的轉址沒有測試，短網址的終點也可能被變更，繼續前請確認最終網址。onelink.to 是共用的第三方短網址服務，只因網站規則要求連結主機必須列入官方網域才列入；請不要把其他 onelink.to 網址當成美廉社官方連結。

兌換券取自個人的分享文案，不是美廉社發送的訊息；文案沒有說明期限、發放總量與使用條件，邀請碼是否被接受，本站也沒有實際註冊測試。依美廉社官網的會員規定，限制行為能力的未成年人須經法定代理人同意。
notes.en:
This link does not carry the invite code, so paste it or type S7wStYD0 in exactly as shown (case-sensitive) when registering. The share text calls it an invite code; the App Store release notes mention a promotion code (推廣碼) at registration. The exact field label in the app was not confirmed, so follow the screen.

The link onelink.to/rte3n3: opened in a desktop browser on 2026-10-24, it redirected to the official Simple Mart website (simplemart.com.tw). The mobile redirect was not tested, and the destination of a short link can be changed, so check the final address before continuing. onelink.to is a shared third-party short-link service, listed only because the site's rules require the link host to be in the official domains; do not treat other onelink.to links as Simple Mart official links.

The coupon comes from an individual's share text, not from a message sent by Simple Mart; the text states no deadline, total supply or conditions, and nobody registered to test whether the code is accepted. Under the membership rules on the Simple Mart website, minors with limited legal capacity need their legal representative's consent.

q.zh-TW: 美廉社的邀請碼要輸入在哪裡？
q.en: Where do I enter the Simple Mart invite code?

a.zh-TW: 在美廉社 App 註冊時輸入邀請碼 S7wStYD0。本站的連結不含邀請碼，點擊「立即註冊」時會先複製；請貼上，若沒有貼上，請手動輸入，並依原樣區分大小寫。
a.en: Enter invite code S7wStYD0 when you register in the Simple Mart app. The link on this site does not carry the code; selecting “Sign up” copies it first. Paste it, or type it in exactly as shown, including capitalization.

q.zh-TW: 輸入邀請碼完成註冊可以得到什麼？
q.en: What do I get for registering with the invite code?

a.zh-TW: 依分享文案，完成註冊可獲得飲品兌換券 1 張（金桔檸檬飲L 或黑糖冬瓜檸檬飲L）。分享文案沒有說明期限、發放總量或使用條件；官方的邀好友推薦禮頁面只以圖片說明流程，實際獎勵以當期活動公告為準。
a.en: According to the share text, finishing registration gets one drink coupon (a 金桔檸檬飲L or a 黑糖冬瓜檸檬飲L). The share text gives no deadline, total supply or conditions; the official invite-a-friend page only shows the flow in images, and the actual reward follows the current campaign announcement.
